text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Another massacre in Ben Achour village, south of Algiers: 16 people slaughtered.
- Workers' union leader Abdelhaq Benhamouda to set up a political party.
- Arab countries back Algeria plan to fight terrorism and adopt a common strategy against terrorism.
- Villagers fought battle with "terrorists" in Ben Achour where 16 people were killed.
- The Transitional National Council debates the government's performance in 1996.
